project.title: Prokaryotes from the AnSBBR subjected to different co-substrates. Raw sequence reads
project.description: Conventional wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) are often ineffective at removing micropollutants (MPs), such as pharmaceuticals and artificial sweeteners, raising environmental concerns. This study evaluated the physicochemical characteristics of raw and treated domestic wastewater from a full-scale aerobic ABC WWTP, and assessed a laboratory-scale Anaerobic Sequencing Batch Biofilm Reactor (AnSBBR) operated with six co-substrates (sucrose, ethanol, lactose, cheese whey, glucose, and glycerin) with respect to the removal of caffeine (CAF), ibuprofen (IBU), diclofenac (DCF), cyclamate (CYC), and sucralose (SUC).
